17:1: Gedha s Win Ibbwin amdan iS, d iminig n yiḍ, si Loamaɛ n Lḥaṛam, ar Loamaɛ ibaɛden maḍi, ideg Neṛqa i as d izzin, iwakken ad as Nessken, seg issekniyen nneɣ. Ih, Neţţa, d Win Isellen, Iţwalin.
17:2: Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, u Nerra ţ d nnhaya i At Isṛail. "Ur sɛut awkil, war Nek".
17:3: D tarwa n wid i Nebbwi akked Nuḥ. Neţţa, s tideţ, d amdan isnemmiren.
17:4: Nsseyya di Tezmamt, i At Isṛail: "war ccekk, a ţţesfesdem, di tmurt, berdayen, u aṭas ara tesmeɣwṛem iman nnwen".
17:5: Mi d iusa usefsed amenzu segsen, Nuzen awen d imdanen nneɣ, s loehd uqsiḥ, kecmen ixxamen; lemɛahda teḍṛa.
17:6: Sinna, Nerra d ţţaṛ nnwen, segsen. Nebbwi yawen d ayla, tarwa. Nesṭuqqet iɛsekṛiwen nnwen.
17:7: Ma tmaɛnem, i iman nnwen, ma tdensem, i iman nnwen. Mi d tusa lemɛahda taneggarut, ssexḍen udmawen nnwen, kecmen Loamaɛ, akken i t kecmen abrid amenzu; hudden, wakali, ayen is iţzuxxun.
17:8: Ahat Mass nnwen ad Iḥun fellawen. Ma tulsem, a Nales. Nerra Loahennama d lḥebs i ijehliyen.
17:9: Ih, Leqwṛan agi inehhu ar wayen iweqmen maḍi, ibecceṛ lmumnin i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni akafi meqqwṛen.
17:10: Wanag wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, Nhegga yasen d aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
17:11: Amdan issawal i cceṛṛ, akken issawal i lxiṛ. Amdan izga d aḥemmaq.
17:12: Nerra, iḍ akked wass, d sin issekniyen. Assekni n yiḍ Nerra d tellis, Nerra win n wass d win iţwalin, iwakken a ţnadim lfeḍl n Mass nnwen, a ţţissinem amḍan iseggwasen, akked leḥsab. Yal taɣawsa, Nfeṣṣel iţ akken iwata.
17:13: I yal amdan, Ncudd as lbext is s amgarḍ is. Ass n tnekra, ad as d Nessuffeɣ tazmamt ara iaf teldi.
17:14: "ɣeṛ tazmamt ik! Tqaddeḍ, assa, s yiman ik, i uqeṭṭi k".
17:15: Win iţwanhan, i iman is kan, win innetlafen, innetlaf mgal iman is kan. Ur iţbibbi yiwen taɛkkwemt n wayeḍ. Ur Nekkat, alamma Nuzen amazan.
17:16: Ma Nebɣa a Nesqucc tamdint, Neţţak lameṛ i isɛiyen is, ad xedmen, degs, cceṛṛ. Ad iɛaddi fellas Wawal, a ţ Nhudd wakali.
17:17: Acḥal n tsuta ay Nesqucc, deffir Nuḥ! Ad Iqadd Mass ik, i tussna akked tmeẓṛiwt ibekkaḍen n imdanen iS.
17:18: Win ibɣan taḥemmaqt, Nezzazzal as degs, i ɣ ihwan, i win i ɣ Nebɣa. Sinna, Nerra yas Loahennama ad din iṛɣ, indell, iţţuḍeggeṛ.
17:19: Win ibɣan laxeṛt, iaɛzem fellas yal laɛzem, u neţţa iumen; widak, tajmilt i laɛzem nnsen.
17:20: I akw, i wigi d wiyaḍ, Nwessaɛ tikci sɣuṛ Mass ik. Tikci n Mass ik, ur meḥdudet.
17:21: Wali amek Nesmenyaf kra i wiyaḍ. War ccekk, di laxeṛt, lfeṛq d usmenyef, ad ilin sennig waya.
17:22: Ur sɛu, ar tama n Ṛebbi, ṛebbi nniḍen, mulac a ţţuɣaleḍ d imdelli, d imḍeggaɛ.
17:23: Iseyya d Mass ik: ur tɛabdem siwa Neţţa, elhut ar imawlan. Ma, ɣuṛek wesser yiwen, neɣ ma wessren i sin, ur asen qqaṛ: "ttfuh"! Ur ten ţţara. Mmeslay asen s lkyasa.
17:24: Zger fellasen tacḍat n lmaḥnana. Ini: "a Mass iw! Ḥun fellasen, akken iyi d ssekren d amejtuḥ".
17:25: Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Issen, i illan deg iman nnwen. Ma telham, Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ wid isteṛoiɛen.
17:26: Efk i llezm ik amur is, akw i umeɣbun akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Ur ţjeggiḥ d ajeggeḥ.
17:27: Ijeggaḥen, s tideţ, d atmaten n Cciṭan. Cciṭan ijhel ar Mass is.
17:28: Ma tfuṛqeḍ ten, tṛeɣbeḍ u tegguniḍ aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass ik, ini yasen awal aẓidan.
17:29: Ur ţcuddu afus ik ar yiri k, ur as berru aṭas, mulac a ţţuɣaleḍ d ambaṣi, d ameɣbun.
17:30: S tideţ, Mass ik Iɣennu win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţwali, Issen imdanen iS.
17:31: Ur Neqqet arraw nnwen, ma tugadem tiggulelt. D Nekwni ara ten Iṛezqen, kunwi yidsen. Ih, timenɣiwt nnsen d tucmiţ meqqwṛen.
17:32: Ur zennut, d ayen n dir, d abrid ucmit.
17:33: Ur neqqet amdan i wen Igdel Ṛebbi, siwa ma di tideţ. Win iţwanɣan s leɣdeṛ, ihi, a Nefk adabu i walag is. Ur iţjuṛṛu di tmenɣiwt, ihi, neţţa, ad iţţusellek.
17:34: Ur ţnalet ayla ugujil, siwa ar wayen imaɛnen, ar d immeḥtel. Qadṛet lemɛahda; ih, lemɛahda s usteqsi.
17:35: Qadṛet lkil ma tektalem, weznet s lmizan imaɛnen. Yif it wakka, a ţţelhu taggara.
17:36: Ur ṭṭafaṛ ayen ur tessineḍ. Timejjin, iẓṛi, ul, s tideţ, ad ţţuseqsin akw.
17:37: Ur teddu di tmurt, d amzuxxi. Ih, kečč ur tezmireḍ, d awezɣi, a ţneqṛeḍ tamurt, neɣ a ţţessiwḍeḍ laɛli idurar.
17:38: Adiran, deg waya akw, Ikerh it Mass ik.
17:39: Ayagi, seg wayen i k Iweḥḥa Mass ik, n ṣṣwab. Ur ţţara, ar tama n Ṛebbi, ṛebbi nniḍen, mulac a ţţeţwaḍeggṛeḍ ar Loahennama d ambaṣi, d amnafeq.
17:40: Day wen d Ifren Mass nnwen arrac, u Iddem, i iman iS, tullas, si lmalayek? S tideţ, kunwi tegrem d awal anecilat.
17:41: Ih, ay d Nebbwi di Leqwṛan agi, iwakken a d mmektin. I yasen d irna, siwa aɣunfu.
17:42: Ini: "lemmer llin yides iṛebbiten, akken la d qqaṛen, yili ad nadin abrid ara ten iawin ar n Bab n usgeld".
17:43: Gedha s yiS, aṭas i Aɛlay sennig wayen d qqaṛen!
17:44: Pţanzen aS igenwan di ṣa, tamurt, u wayen illan degsen. Ur illi wayen ur aS neţţanez, ur T Nesbuccuɛ s ccekṛan. Maca, ur tfehmem ara annuz nnsen. Ih, Neţţa Iḥellem, Iţsemmiḥ.
17:45: Mara teqqaṛeḍ Leqwṛan, Neţţara, garak d wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, aḥurrim abaḍni.
17:46: Nerra ɣef ulawen nnsen ssteṛ, iwakken ur t fehmen; di tmejjin nnsen, tiɛẓegt. Ma tesmektiḍ d, di Leqwṛan, Mass ik d Yiwen, ad zzin akin, s uɣunfu.
17:47: Nekwni, Nif akw akken Neẓṛa, acu iwumi sellen, mara k ssemḥasen, mara hedṛen, mi qqaṛen imednas: "la teţţeddum kan d urgaz iwumi sseḥren".
17:48: Wali amek i k d bbwin imedyaten. Nnetlafen. Ur zmiren ad afen abrid.
17:49: Nnan: "day mi nuɣal d iɣsan, d aɣwebbaṛ, d ṣṣeḥ a d nuɣal di lxelq amaynut"?
17:51: neɣ d lxelq id iusan deg idmaren nnwen". A d inin: "anwa ara a ɣ d irren"? Ini: "d Win ikwen id Ixelqen, abrid amenzu". Ad huzen iqweṛṛa nnsen ɣuṛek, ad inin: "melmi ayagi"? Ini: "izmer ad yili iqeṛb ed".
17:52: Ass ideg ara awen d Isiwel, a d tjawbem s ccekṛan iS, a ţɣilem cwiṭ kan ay teqqimem.
17:53: Ini i imdanen iw ad inin awal ifuqen. Cciṭan, s tideţ, isskar ameṛẓi garasen. Ih, Cciṭan d acengu n ṣṣeḥ i umdan.
17:54: Mass nnwen Yif akw akken ikwen Issen. Ad Iḥun fellawen, ma Ibɣa; a kwen Iɛaqeb ma Ibɣa. Ur k id Nuzen ara d awkil nnsen.
17:55: Mass ik Yif akw akken Iẓṛa i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Niɣ Nesmenyaf kra n lambiyya i wiyaḍ. I Dawed Nefka Ihellilen.
17:56: Ini: "nujet ɣeṛ wid teţkabarem, war Neţţa. Ur zmiren ad awen kksen ccqa, neɣ a t bedlen.
17:57: Wigi uɣuṛ la ţnujun, la ţqelliben ţţawil ara ten isqeṛben nezzeh ar Mass nnsen. Ssaramen aḥunu S, ţţagwaden aɛaqeb iS". Ih, aɛaqeb n Mass ik, issagwad.
17:58: Ur telli temdint ur Nesquccu, uqbel ass n tnekra, neɣ ur Nɛaqeb s leqseḥ. Ayagi iura di Tezmamt.
17:59: I ɣ iṭṭfen ɣef uceggaɛ issekniyen, d nnkeṛ nnsen, kan, sɣuṛ imezwura. Nuzen ed talɣwemt i Tamud, d ayen ţwalin. Densen ţ. Ur d Neţţazen issekniyen siwa i ussigwed.
17:60: Mi k Nenna: "Mass ik, s tideţ, Izzi i imdanen". Ma dayen i k Nerra teẓṛiḍ t, d ahewwel kan i medden. Akken ttejṛa tamenɛult di Leqwṛan. Nessagwad iten. Ay sen d irennu siwa nnfaq ameqwṛan.
17:61: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem", knant, siwa Iblis. Inna: "day ad knuɣ i win Txelqeḍ s talaxt"?
17:62: Inna: "Twalaḍ wagi i Tɛuzzeḍ sennig iw, lemmer a yi Teooeḍ, ar ass n tnekra, war ccekk, ad ɣwuɣ tarwa s, siwa ixeṭṭayen".
17:63: Inna: "Ṛuḥ! Wid, segsen, i iddan yidek, ihi, aqeṭṭi nnwen d Loahennama, d aqeṭṭi meqqwṛen.
17:64: Laɛaj win iwumi tzemṛeḍ, degsen, s taɣwect ik. ɣewwes fellasen s imnayen ik, d iterrasen ik. Ecrek yidsen ayla, tarwa. Ɛahed asen". I yasen iɛahed Cciṭan, siwa aɣuṛṛu.
17:65: " Ma d imdanen iW, ur tesɛiḍ adabu fellasen". Mass ik Iqadd d Awkil.
17:66: Mass nnwen, i wen Isselḥayen lbabuṛ di yill, a ţnadim lfeḍl iS. Ih, Neţţa Iţḥunu fellawen.
17:67: Ma teḍṛa yidwen lmuṣiba di yill, ayen uɣuṛ teţnujum, war Neţţa, ittellif. Mi kwen Isellek ar lberr, twexxṛem. Amdan izga d lkaraɛ.
17:68: Day tɣilem ur Iţseggix ara tamurt yiswen, neɣ ur awen d Iţţazen ara tabuciḍant, dɣa ur teţţafem awkil?
17:69: Neɣ day tɣilem ur kwen id Iţţara ara tikelt nniḍen, ad awen d Iazen aṣeṛṣaṛ, a kwen Iɣmes ilmend n tijehli nnwen, sinna ur teţţafem, mgal aɣ, amalal?
17:70: Niɣ Nkeyyes tarwa n Adem. Nebbwi ten di lberr, di yill, Nɣat iten s wayen ilhan, Nesmenyaf iten, nezzeh, i waṭas seg wid i Nexleq.
17:71: Ass ideg ara Nenced akw imdanen, s imḍebṛen nnsen; win id tusa tezmamt is yeffus is, widak ad ɣṛen tazmamt nnsen, ur ţwadensen s tissegnit;
17:72: win illan d aderɣal di tagi, ad yili d aderɣal di laxeṛt, ad izid di tuffɣa n ubrid.
17:73: S tideţ, qṛib i k hewwlen ɣef wayen i k d Nweḥḥa, a d tesnulfuḍ ayen nniḍen, mgal aɣ. Dɣa, a k rren d aḥbib.
17:74: Lemmer ur k Ntebbet ara, qṛib tmaleḍ cwiṭ ɣuṛsen.
17:75: Yili ad ak Nesɛaddi tudert akked tmeţţant, berdayen, sinna, ur teţţafeḍ, mgal aɣ, w ara k isellken.
17:76: Ih, qṛib i k id srewlen si tmurt, a k id ssuffɣen segs. Yili cwiṭ kan ara d gwrin, deffir ek.
17:77: D tannumi imazanen nneɣ, id Nuzen, uqbel ik. Ur teţţafeḍ ara abeddel, di lɛadda nneɣ.
17:78: Bedd i tẓallit mi istuɣla yiṭij, alamma d tellis n yiḍ. Leqwṛan, tafrara. Ih, Leqwṛan, tafrara, isɛa inagan.
17:79: Aɛwez yis kra n yiḍ, d nnafila k, amar a k id Irr Mass ik, deg umkan i ţcekkiṛen.
17:80: Ini: "a Mass iw! Ssekcem iyi, anekcum n tideţ. Ssuffeɣ iyi, tuffɣa n tideţ. Efk iyi, sɣuṛeK, adabu iţselliken".
17:81: Ini: "tusa d tideţ, ɣabent tkerkas. Ih, tikerkas ilaq ad ɣabent".
17:82: Nesrusu d, si Leqwṛan, ayen illan d ḥellu akked uḥunu i lmumnin. I irennu, i imednas, siwa lexsaṛa.
17:83: Ma Nɣat amdan ad iwexxeṛ, ad iḍeṛṛef iman is. Ma iḥuza t wugur ad iayes.
17:84: Ini: "yal yiwen ixeddem akken iţwali. Mass nnwen Yif akw akken i Issen anwa i iţwanhan kteṛ".
17:85: Steqsan k id ɣef ṛṛuḥ. Ini: "ṛṛuḥ si lameṛ n Mass iw. Drus kan n tmusni i wen iţţunefken".
17:86: Ma ihwa yaɣ, a Nekkes ayen i k Nweḥḥa. Dɣa ur teţţafeḍ, mgal aɣ, awkil,
17:87: siwa aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ih, lfeḍl iS, i kečč, izga meqqweṛ.
17:88: Ini: "lemmer ad mlilen imdanen akked leonun, iwakken a d awin am Leqwṛan agi, ur d ţţawin i t icban, xas mɛawanen".
17:89: Niɣ Nefka d i imdanen, di Leqwṛan agi, si yal imedyaten. Tegwti n yimdanen ur bɣin, siwa tijehli.
17:90: Nnan: "ur k neţţamen alamma tesfeggḍeḍ aɣ d aɣbalu, si tmurt;
17:91: neɣ, tesɛiḍ leonan n tezdayin akked tfeṛṛant, ideg feggḍen isaffen;
17:92: neɣ, a d tesseɣliḍ igenni d ifeṣlan, akken i ɣ tzuxxeḍ; neɣ, a d taseḍ s Ṛebbi akked lmalayek, zdat nneɣ;
17:93: Neɣ a ţţesɛuḍ axxam imzewweq, neɣ a ţţaliḍ s igenni. Ur neţţamen, s walluy ik, alamma tesserseḍ aneɣ d tazmamt ara nɣeṛ". Ini: "gedha s Mass iw! Day lliɣ d ayen nniḍen, siwa d amdan amazan"?
17:94: I iṭṭfen imdanen ur uminen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, mara d inin kan: "Iuzen ed Ṛebbi amdan d amazan".
17:95: Ini: "lemmer llint, di tmurt, lmalayek, teddunt di laman, yili Nessers asent ed, seg igenni, lmelk amazan".
17:96: Ini: "Iqadd Mass iw d Anagi, gari yidwen. Neţţa, s tideţ, Iţwali imdanen iS, Issen iten".
17:97: Win Inha Ṛebbi, atan idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef, ur asen teţţafeḍ imawlan, war Neţţa, d awezɣi. A ten id Nefser ass n tnekra ɣef udmawen nnsen, dreɣlen, gugmen, ɛaẓgen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. Mi tenqes tmes, ad asen Nernu ajajiḥ.
17:98: D wagi ay d aqeṭṭi nnsen, imi nekṛen issekniyen nneɣ, u nnan: "day mi nuɣal d iɣsan, d aɣwebbaṛ, a d nuɣal di lxelq amaynut"?
17:99: Neɣ, day ur walan ara ar Ṛebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, Izmer a d Ixleq i ten icban? Irra yasen lajel, ur degs ccekk. Ur bɣin imednas, siwa tijehli.
17:100: Ini: "lemmer tesɛim igerrujen uḥunu n Mass iw, ur ten teţnalem, a ţţagwadem a ten tṣeṛṛfem. Amdan izga d imceḥḥi".
17:101: Niɣ Nefka, i Musa, tza issekniyen iberrzen. Steqsi At Isṛail. Mi d iusa ɣuṛsen, inna yas Ferɛun: "a Musa! Nek, walaɣ, war ccekk, seḥḥern ak".
17:102: Inna: "niɣ teẓṛiḍ ur d issers yiwen wigi, d tiftilin, siwa Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Nek, walaɣ, a Ferɛun, war ccekk, tṭeḥḥneḍ".
17:103: Ibɣa a ten iẓẓaɛ si tmurt, Nɣemmeq it, akked wid iddan yides, meṛṛa.
17:104: Deffir es, Nenna i At Isṛail: "zedɣet tamurt. Mi d tusa lemɛahda n laxeṛt, a kwen id Nawi, d ṭayfat".
17:105: Nessers it id s tideţ. S tideţ, ay d irs. Nuzen ik id, kan, i ubecceṛ d uneddeṛ.
17:106: Leqwṛan Nfeṛq it, iwakken a t temleḍ i medden, s laɛqel. Nessader it id, s lɣeṛḍ.
17:107: Ini: "amnet yis, neɣ qqimet". Ih, ma mlan t i wid tebbweḍ tussna, uqbel is, ad ɣlin ɣef udmawen, knan.
17:108: Ad inin: "gedha s Mass nneɣ! Tṣaṛ lemɛahda n Mass nneɣ".
17:109: Ad ɣlin ɣef udmawen s imeṭṭawen. Ad innerni wannuz nnsen.
17:110: Ini: "nujet ɣer Ṛebbi, neɣ nujet ɣer Uḥnin. Akken tnujem, ineS ismawen imaɛnen yifen akw wiyaḍ". Di tẓallit ik, ur saɛlay ṣṣut ik, ur t ssrusu. Ad isker kan.
17:111: Ini: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, ur Nesɛi aqcic, ur Nesɛi acrik di tgelda, ur Nesɛi bab mgal asdullu". Ssemɣweṛ iT yal temɣweṛ.
18:1: Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, id Issersen Tazmamt, i uxdim iS. Aɛwaj, degs, ur Irri.
18:2: Tewqem, iwakken a ţţɛaggen ɣef ssxeḍ uwɛiṛ, sɣuṛeS; u a ţbecceṛ lmumnin ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar nnsen warraz igerzen.
18:4: A ţţɛaggen i wid innan: "Ṛebbi Isɛa mmi S".
18:5: Ur illi wayen ssnen fellas; akken, imezwura nnsen. D awal uqbiḥ id iffɣen seg imawen nnsen. D tikerkas kan ay ssawalen.
18:6: Ahat a ţhelkeḍ iman ik, ar loiha nnsen, a ţɣwebleḍ, imi ur uminen ara s usali agi?
18:7: Niɣ Nerra i illan di tmurt, d ccbaḥa ines, iwakken a Nẓeṛ menyif iten, ar igiten ilhan.
18:8: A Nuɣal a Nerr, i illan degs, d akal ibuṛen.
18:9: Neɣ tɣileḍ d At yifri kan, akked Ṛaqim, ay d lwehma, ger issekniyen nneɣ?
18:10: Mi ssṛen iman nnsen ilmeẓiyen deg ifri, nnan: "a Mass nneɣ! Efk aneɣ d aḥunu sɣuṛeK; Err aɣ lameṛ nneɣ d uṣwib".
18:11: Deg ifri, Nesleɣ imeẓẓuɣen nnsen, acḥal iseggwasen.
18:12: Sinna, Nessker iten id, a Nẓeṛ anta, ger snat n trebbuyaɛ, i iḥesben acḥal qqimen.
18:13: Nekwni, ad ak Neḥku, s tideţ, taqsiṭ nnsen. Nitni, ih, d ilmeẓiyen, umnen s Mass nnsen. Nerna yasen nnhaya.
18:14: Nesseohed ulawen nnsen, mi kren nnan: "Mass nneɣ d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur neţnuju, d awezɣi, ar ṛebbi, war Neţţa, mulac a d nini awal dduni.
18:15: Widak d agdud nneɣ. Ɛabden iṛebbiten, war Neţţa. Ayɣeṛ ur aɣ d bbwin, fellasen, adabu n ṣṣeḥ? Anwa i idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi?
18:16: Mi ten tfuṛqem, nitni akked wayen ɛabden war Ṛebbi, essṛet iman nwen deg ifri. Ad awen Izraɛ, Mass nnwen, seg uḥunu S. Ad awen Iheggi amwanes i lameṛ nnwen".
18:17: A ţwaliḍ iṭij, mi d inqeṛ, iwexxeṛ i ifri nnsen, ar yeffus. Mi iɣli, ad asen iɛaddi ɣeṛ zelmeḍ. Nitni, din, di littsaɛ. Ayagi seg issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Win Inha Ṛebbi, neţţa iţwanha; win Itlef, ur isɛi, d awezɣi, bab ara t inhun.
18:18: Ad as tiniḍ ukin, nitni ṭṭsen. Ntezzi ten yeffus, zelmeḍ. Aydi nnsen, ɣef umnaṛ, iẓẓel iḍaṛen is. Lemmer a ten twaliḍ, ad asen trewleḍ, si tugdi; a k terkeb, segsen, lefqaɛ.
18:19: Akka ay ten id Nessenker, iwakken ad mesteqsin. Inna yiwen segsen: "acḥal n lweqt ay tesɛaddam"? Nnan d: "nesɛadda ass neɣ ur ibbwiḍ wass". Nnan: "Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Izṛa ay tesɛaddam. Aznet ar temdint, yiwen segwen, s idrimen agi nnwen. Ad iwali anwa lqut iṣfan maḍi, ad awen d iawi ṛṛeẓq, segs. Ad iḥader iman is, iwakken ur awen iţfaq yiwen.
18:20: Nitni, war ccekk, ma ẓṛan kwen, a kwen ṛeomen, neɣ a kwen rren ar ddin nnsen, dɣa ur trebḥen, d awezɣi".
18:21: Akka ay sen ten Nessken, iwakken ad ẓṛen ar lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tideţ; u, ɣef yimir, ur illi ccekk. Mi mqellaɛn ɣef lameṛ nnsen, nnan: "bnut axxam sennig sen. Mass nnsen Yif akw akken iten Issen". Nnan wid iwumi iɛadda wawal, ɣef lameṛ nnsen: "a nerr, ihi, lemqam sennig sen".
18:22: Ad inin: "di kraḍ yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis kuẓ"; u ad inin: "di semus yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis sdis", ţqelliben tabaḍnit. U ad inin: "di ṣa yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis ṭam". Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Iẓṛa amḍan nnsen. Drus kan i t iẓṛan". Ur ţnamar fellasen, siwa ɣef wayen id iḍehṛen. Ur ţţesteqsay yiwen fellasen.
18:23: Ur qqaṛ taɣawsa a ţ xedmeɣ, s tideţ, azekka,
18:24: siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi. Mmekti d Mass ik, ma teţţuḍ. Ini: "amar ad iyi Inhu Mass iw, ar wayen yifen ayagi di ṣṣwab".
18:25: Sɛaddan, deg ifri nnsen, kraḍ twinas iseggwasen, rnan tza nniḍen.
18:26: Ini: "Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Iẓṛa, acḥal sɛaddan. IneS tabaḍnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Amek Neţţa Iţwali, Isell! Ur sɛin bab, war Neţţa. Ur Izdukkul yiwen i useyyi S".
18:27: Mel ayen ik ed iţţuweḥḥan, si Tezmamt n Mass ik. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Ur teţţafeḍ ssṛan, war Neţţa, d awezɣi.
18:28: Ṣebbeṛ iman ik, akked wid iţnujun ar Mass nnsen, taṣebḥit, tameddit, ţnadin udem iS. Ur ten tekkes si ger wallen ik, a ţḍemɛaḍ lefnun n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ur ssemḥas i win iwumi Nesseɣfel ul is, ar usmekti nneɣ, i iddan d lhawiyya s, iwumi iffuhri lameṛ.
18:29: Ini: "tideţ sɣuṛ Mass nnwen. Ad iamen win ibɣan, ad ijhel win ibɣan". Ih, Nhegga d times, i imednas; ad asen zzin iḥeoouoa s. Ma ţţren d, ad asen ţţunefken waman am uzzal ifsin. Ad cwin wudmawen nnsen. A tissit tamcumt, a tanezduɣt tucmiţ!
18:30: Ih, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, s tideţ, ur Nḍeggiɛ akafi n win ixedmen ayen ilhan.
18:31: I wigi, leonanat n Ɛaden, ddaw sen isaffen ţţazzalen. Ad qqnen, dinna, imeqyasen n ddheb, ad lsen iceṭṭiḍen izegzawen n leḥrir, ḥewcen s ddheb. Ad ẓlen, degs, ɣef imṭeṛḥen izewwqen. A lebsa lɛali, a tanezduɣt tumɛint!
18:32: Awi yasen d amedya n sin irgazen. I yiwen, Nefka snat tebḥirin n tẓuṛin, Nezzi yasent tizdayin, Nerra iger garasent.
18:33: Yal tibḥirt teţţak ed lɣella s, ur iţxuṣṣu, segs, wacemma. Nesfeggeḍ asif garasent.
18:34: Iɣellet ed ţţemṛa. Inna i umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "ɣelbeɣ k taṛkunt, iffeɣ k alag".
18:35: Idens iman is mi ikcem leonan is, inna: "ur cukkeɣ ara, d awezɣi, ad iqucc wayagi.
18:36: Ur cukkeɣ ara ad yili yimir, u ma bbwḍeɣ ar Mass iw, ard affeɣ, war ccekk, ayen yifen aya, deg umekkan is".
18:37: Inna yas umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "day tnekṛeḍ Win ik Ixelqen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit, sinna, Imessel ik d argaz?
18:38: Maca, Neţţa d Ṛebbi, Mass iw. Ur ţcarakeɣ yiwen, i Mass iw.
18:39: Lemmer id tenniḍ, mi tkecmeḍ ar tebḥirt ik: akken Irad Ṛebbi. Ur telli tezmert siwa sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Ma twalaḍ iyi d, nek, tifeḍ iyi ayla, tarwa,
18:40: Izmer Mass iw ad iyi d Ifk ayen i ifen tibḥirt ik. A d Iazen ɣuṛes ssxeḍ, seg igenni, a ţţuɣal d aḥecraruf issiccigen;
18:41: neɣ, ad zzren waman is, ur ten teţţafeḍ, d awezɣi".
18:42: Tqucc lɣella s. Dɣa la izeyyeṛ ifassen is, ɣef wayen iseṛṛef fellas. Tqucc tfeṛṛant is. Inna: "a yamxix iw, a lemmer ur curkeɣ yiwen, i Mass iw"!
18:43: Ur as illi urbaɛ ara t isellken, war Ṛebbi. Ur isellek iman is.
18:44: Akka, laɛnaya sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Tideţ. Yif akw i ukafi, Yif akw i taggara.
18:45: Awi yasen d amedya n tmeddurt n ddunit. Am aman id Nesseɣli seg igenni. Eɛluɛlen yissen imɣan n tmurt. Dɣa uɣalen d asaɣuṛ, issebruzzaɛ iten waḍu. Niɣ Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
18:46: Ayla akked dderya d ccbaḥa n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ar Mass ik, leṣlaḥ idumen ifen ten i ukafi, ifen ten i tmeṛoiwt.
18:47: Ass ideg ara Nesselḥu idurar, a ţwaliḍ tamurt d azaɣaṛ. A ten Nefser, ur Neţţaoa yiwen segsen.
18:48: A d rsen zdat Mass ik, d leṣfuf: "niɣ tusam aɣ d, akken ikwen Nexleq tikelt tamenzut. Irna tetebbtem ar ur awen Neţţara ţţaɛud, d awezɣi".
18:49: Ters ed Tezmamt. A ţwaliḍ ibeɣwḍiyen s uḥebbiṛ, ɣef wayen illan degs. Qqaṛen: "a yamxix nneɣ! Acimi tazmamt agi ur teooi ayen meẓẓiyen, u wayen meqqwṛen, armi ten teḥseb"? Ufan illa wayen xedmen. Mass ik ur Idennis yiwen.
18:50: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem", knant, siwa Iblis. Neţţa, si leonun, iaɛṣa lameṛ n Mass is. Day a ten terrem, neţţa akked tarwa s, d imawlan, war Nek? U nitni d icenga nnwen! D abdil ucmit n imednas.
18:51: Ur ten Rriɣ d inagan n lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, neɣ n lxelq nnsen. Ur Ṭṭifeɣ imɣeṛṛqen d imɛiwnen.
18:52: Ass ideg ara d Yini: "neccdet wid iyI terram d icriken iW". Ad asen siwlen, ur asen d ţţaran. Nerra, garasen, asif n twaɣit.
18:53: Ibeɣwḍiyen ad walin times. Ḥṣan ar nitni, degs, ara ɣlin. Ur ţţafen, segs, tisensert.
18:54: Niɣ Nefka d, di Leqwṛan agi, yal amedya, i imdanen. Maca, iţnamar umdan sennig akw.
18:55: D acu i iṭṭfen imdanen ad amnen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, u ad steɣfṛen Mass nnsen? Ar ten id tas kan, tin iḍṛan d imezwura, neɣ ar d irs, zdat sen, uɛaqeb?
18:56: Ur Neţţazen imazanen, siwa i ubecceṛ d uneddeṛ. Wid ijehlen ţnamaren, s tkerkas, ṭṭeggiṛen yissent tideţ. Pmaɛliken ɣef issekniyen iW, akked wayen iɣef ţţunedṛen.
18:57: Anwa idensen sennig win iwumi d ţwafekkṛen issekniyen n Mass is, iwexxeṛ asen, u iţţu i ixdem ufus is. Ih, Nerra aḥurrim ɣef wulawen nnsen, ur t fehhmen; akked tiɛẓegt deg imeẓẓuɣen nnsen. Ma tneccdeḍ ten ar nnhaya, ur ţwanhan, d awezɣi.
18:58: Mass ik Iţsemmiḥen, d Bab uḥunu. Lemmer ad Iḥud fellasen ilmend n wayen kesben, ad Iɣiwel ar uɛaqeb nnsen. Maca, sɛan ţţaɛud, ur ţţafen segs tisensert.
18:59: Timdinin nni i Nesqucc mi densent, Nga ţţaɛud i usquccu nnsent.
18:60: Mi inna Musa i uqeddac is: "ur ḥebbseɣ alamma bbwḍeɣ ar umlili n sin ilellen, xas ad sɛaddiɣ tallit".
18:61: Mi bbwḍen ar umlili nnsen, ţţun aslem nnsen. Iuɣal ar yill d ilelli.
18:62: Mi zegren, inna i uqeddac is: "awi aɣ d imekli nneɣ, niɣ naɛteb deg inig nneɣ agi".
18:63: Inna: "ur twalaḍ ara, mi nreyyeḥ ar teẓṛut, nek ţţuɣ en aslem? D Cciṭan kan iyi isseţţun ur ak nniɣ. Ibbwi abrid is ar yill, d lwehma"!
18:64: Inna: "d ayagi ay nebɣa". Dɣa uɣalen d ɣef isurifen nnsen.
18:65: Ufan d amdan seg imdanen nneɣ, iwumi Nefka aḥunu sɣuṛneɣ. Neslemd as tussna i illan ɣuṛneɣ.
18:66: Inna yas Musa: "Ma ad dduɣ yidek, ad iyi tesḥefḍeḍ ay tesneḍ n ṣṣwab"?
18:67: Inna d: "kečč, s tideţ, ur tezmiṛeḍ, yidi, a ţṣebṛeḍ.
18:68: Amek ara tṣebṛeḍ i wayen iɣef ur tesɛiḍ asali"?
18:69: Inna: "ad iyi tafeḍ, ma Irad Ṛebbi, d aṣebṛi. Ur ţnaqwameɣ lameṛ ik".
18:70: Inna: "ma teddiḍ yidi, ur iyi d steqsay ɣef wacemma, alamma smektiɣ k id fellas".
18:71: Lḥan, armi rekben di lbabuṛ. Ixeṛq it. Inna: "txeṛqeḍ t, iwakken ad ɣeḍṣen lɣaci s! Niɣ ayen txedmeḍ d dduni".
18:72: Inna: "day ur ak nniɣ ara, kečč, s tideţ, ur tezmiṛeḍ, yidi, a ţṣebṛeḍ, d awezɣi"?
18:73: Inna: "ur iyi ţqasa imi ţţuɣ, ur ssukku lwaɛṛan ɣef lameṛ iw".
18:74: Lḥan, armi d mmugren ilemẓi. Inɣa t. Inna: "tenɣiḍ amdan ur nenɣi yiwen! Niɣ d ayen idensen ay txedmeḍ".
